Looking for an alternative to my HP Instant Ink Printer for higher-volume printing
I currently have an HP AIO with an Instant Ink subscription.  I want to get away from it because I don't think I'm getting any savings from it.  With our growing family being homeschooled, we're printing over 1500 pages per month.  The wakeup call was this morning with a \~$200 bill.  I have a bunch of unused cartriges of a two or three colors in storage by the printer as well.  The printer itself is nearly 3 years old and I think it's getting worn out and needs a replacement.

  
HP Instant Ink was nice when we didn't have so much printing, but they've got their business figured out and now I'm paying for it.  What's an alternative that would suit my needs?
